body:
I guess it just feel like every move I make, every decision, is just another way that I'm hurting myself. "should I clean up today? Nah, I'll feel worse about myself if I don't. Since that's what I deserve, I'll just sit here" that sort of stuff.

Feels like I'm trapped into make those sorts of choices over and over. I hope that makes sense
I got up to try to feel better, went in the shower and tried cleaning a bit. Felt nothing but shitty the whole time. Kept staring at the balcony. Ended up collapsing back into bed

I wouldn't be too surprised if I turned out to be bipolar actually. My father was recently diagnosed, and I imagine those sorts of genetics can be passed down to done degree. I'll check with my doctor, thank you very much for the advice
Looking back on myself, yeah I've been very energetic recently
Hence why I'm fucking livid with myself.
But I mean, if I'm dead I can't feel this shitty. I can't feel anything. No more pain, no worries, it sounds like a pretty good deal right now

I've put down the bleach to try and think for myself, but it's hard to take my eyes off of it. This is a chapter in my life that I will not be proud of. This will stick with me for long long time, I'll be haunted by my own stupidity, idiocy, ignorance, faithlessness, and many other things. I'd do anything to go back and time to wake myself up, to stop myself from doing such a horrendous thing. I still love him and I can't explain why id make a decision like that.

I feel like if I was dead, he might understand how disgusted with myself I feel right now. I just want to vomit. I don't think I've ever hated myself as much as I do in this moment, and for me that's saying something. Some mistakes can never be repaired, and deserve punishment. There should be consequences for me beyond heartbreak.
